proposals.evidence: Andersen's as- 'to exist, to be' head explicitly compares RV asti and Pali atthi and discusses first-person sumi. Turner 977 ásti 'is' names √as, gives Pali atthi and attested Ashokan asti/athi, and describes first-person asmi. This is the matching inherited verbal family; the lexical source head uses the root stem rather than the finite form.

proposals.evidence: Andersen's gam- 'to go' head explicitly compares RV gam- (gacchati) and Pali gacchati, cross-referencing adhigam-/upagata-. Turner 3955 gácchati 'goes' explicitly marks √gam, cites Pali gacchati and Ashokan gacheyaṁ/gachema/gachati. The source head is the root-stem label for this matching inherited verb, not a claim that gam- itself is an attested finite inscriptional spelling.
